title: Trident Alk Reading Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Reef-tank parameters (`reeftank:param`), vivarium climate (`vivarium:climate`), fish feeder (`fishfeeder:event`), auto-doser (`doser:event`), auto-top-off (`ato:event`), pond sensors (`pondsensor:reading`).
app: Aquarium and vivarium controllers — reef-tank parameter monitors, auto-dosers, auto-top-off, reptile terrarium climate/UVB, and pond sensors — via MQTT and controller APIs (Apex, GHL, ESPHome).
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trident:alk
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by tank_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>1
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Trident alk reading data has stopped arriving for a given tank.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per tank and alert when the feed is older than 1 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It charts when one part of your Trident alk reading feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
